final: WITH site_ratios AS (SELECT s.zoneregistry, s.insurstat, AVG(1.0 * m.facetresmm / NULLIF(m.geomdeltamm, 0)) AS avg_ratio, COUNT(m.facetregistry) AS mesh_records FROM sites AS s JOIN scanmesh AS m ON s.zoneregistry = m.zoneref WHERE s.insurstat IS NOT NULL GROUP BY s.zoneregistry, s.insurstat), status_avgs AS (SELECT insurstat, AVG(avg_ratio) AS status_avg FROM site_ratios GROUP BY insurstat), kept AS (SELECT r.*, a.status_avg FROM site_ratios AS r JOIN status_avgs AS a ON r.insurstat = a.insurstat WHERE r.avg_ratio > a.status_avg) SELECT insurstat, AVG(avg_ratio) AS avg_kept_ratio, SUM(mesh_records) AS total_mesh_records, AVG(avg_ratio - status_avg) AS avg_excess FROM kept GROUP BY insurstat
